'''Retroact Rain''' is a form of [[Waveworn Phenomenon]].

==Overview==
Retroact Rain consists of condensed [[Remnant]] Energy from the [[Etheric Sea]].<ref name="ACT5">{{Quest|Rewinding Raindrops}}</ref><ref name="ACT6">{{Quest|Grand Warstorm}}</ref> Since Remnant Energy records events across time and space, the rain conjures illusions of past events to those exposed to it, and a stronger emotional connection to the affected area leads to experiencing more intense hallucinations.<ref name="ACT6" />

While usually a harmless phenomenon in itself, the Remnant Energy makes it a magnet for [[Tacet Discord]]s, and the power of a [[Ovathrax|Threnodian]] can greatly enhance the effects of the rain.<ref name="ACT6" />

The frequencies of those who die in the Retroact Rain will be trapped in the rain.

===Phantoms===
Phantoms refer to the projections conjured by the Retroact Rain. When it rains across a large area, it can project memories of multiple people at once, and in a battleground such as [[Jinzhou]], this would result in thousands of Phantoms of dead soldiers and Tacet Discords. During Threnodian-enhanced Retroact Rain, these Phantoms are given a physical form and the ability to inflict harm on real people.<ref name="ACT6" />

For someone to be projected as a Phantom, they must have had prior exposure to the rain and a deep connection to the affected area.<ref name="ACT6" />

===Stages===
Before it forms, Retroact Rain goes through three stages:
*'''First Stage:''' The phenomenon appears identical to normal rain.<ref name="ACT5" />
*'''Second Stage:''' Water droplets float completely still in midair, as if time is frozen.<ref name="ACT5" />
*'''Third Stage:''' Water droplets fall upwards, as if in reverse.<ref name="ACT6" />

==History==
===Threnodian-Enhanced Retroact Rain===
The first recorded instance of Threnodian-enhanced Retroact Rain ever happening was during the [[Battle Beneath the Crescent]], fought against [[Ovathrax]] in the [[Norfall Barrens]], three years prior to the start of the story.<ref name="ACT5" />

A second case of Threnodian-enhanced Retroact Rain occurs again in the [[Main Quests|Main Quest]] [[Chapter I]]: Act VI - ''[[Grand Warstorm]]'', again in the Norfall Barrens as well as [[Desorock Highland]].<ref name="ACT6" />

===Research into Retroact Rain===
There have been many independent studies on Retroact Rain, most of which were conducted by researches who wanted to relive a previous experience or reunite with their loved ones. However, a group of [[Court of Savantae]] researchers expelled by the Committee had attempted a large scale "Artificial Retroactive Rain" project. Funded by an unnamed male [[Fractsidus]] Overseer, the researchers built a remote facility where they attempted to recreate a 'divine miracle' that they had witnessed. The experiment was never completed, and the researchers all vanished, having been devoured by the [[Mech Abomination]] they created.<ref name="ACT5" />

Following the Battle Beneath the Crescent, videos recorded by the [[Midnight Rangers|Midnight Rangers']] [[Geshu Lin|previous General]] has allowed other nations to to speed up their research on defense against the Retroact Rain. In addition to this, an antidote has since then been developed by the [[Huaxu Academy|Academy]] for the Retroact Rain, minimizing the effects of the hallucinations.<ref name="ACT5" />

===Known Affected Areas===
*[[Desorock Highland]]
*[[Norfall Barrens]]
*[[Nostalgia Isle]]

==Trivia==
*[[Dripsnail]]s are usually spotted after Retroact Rains. When their shells are crushed, nearby creatures will hear a sound similar to the rain.<ref>[[Dripsnail]]</ref>
*While certain manifestations within the [[Dark Tide]] in [[Rinascita]] mirror the effects of Retroact Rain, they have not been explicitly classified as such. It remains unconfirmed whether these instances represent a distinct phenomenon or are simply the same occurrence under a different regional designation.
